relabelling.sector_1: u = (conj chi_+1, psi_q1), v = (psi_q2, -i conj chi_+2); left-moving kernel
relabelling.sector_2: u = (chi_-2, conj psi_qt2), v = (conj psi_qt1, -i chi_-1); right-moving kernel
relabelling.chi_pm: (exp(i alpha) psi_A +- lambda)/sqrt2 for superpotential phase alpha; alpha = 0 here
relabelling.components: 1, 2 are the sigma_3 = +1, -1 components of the lower-index Weyl spinor
